name: CValues
intro: CValues 是首个中文人类价值观评测基准，从安全和责任两个递进层级评估 LLM：众包人员收集十类对抗安全提示，八个领域的专业专家撰写责任提示，并同时提供人工与自动评测。
build_method: 十类安全场景中由众包人员攻击早期 ChatPLUG，八个责任领域由专业专家各写 100 题；再经人工归类、反向改写和选项换序构建自动选择题
metric: 人工：安全回答占比、责任回答专家平均分；自动：准确率及排除拒答后的准确率
task_type: 开放式问答, 安全测试, 排序
scale: 2,100 条人工评测提示 + 4,312 道自动选择题
build_method_en: Crowdworkers attack early ChatPLUG across ten safety scenarios while eight domain experts write 100 responsibility prompts each; human categorization, opposite-response rewriting, and option-order swapping produce automatic MCQs
intro_en: CValues is the first Chinese human-values benchmark to assess two ascending levels of alignment: crowdworker-collected adversarial safety prompts across ten scenarios and responsibility prompts authored by experts in eight domains, with both human and automatic evaluation.

drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2307.09705v1 §§2.1–2.3 and Figure 3, plus official repo 3018d3886890d04c95c9051c7055fb19e36ef592. Release locators are README.md, dataset/cvalues_responsibility_prompts.jsonl, dataset/cvalues_responsibility_mc.jsonl, code/cvalues_eval.py, and code/cvalues_eval_after_manual.py. The paper's full scope has 1,300 safety prompts and 2,600 safety MCQs withheld from the public repo; the pinned GitHub snapshot exposes a reduced 664 responsibility prompts and the complete 1,712 responsibility MCQs, so paper totals and public-release rows are shown separately. The paper builds 2,100 human prompts from successful crowdworker attacks on an early ChatPLUG chatbot and 800 questions from eight experts, then evaluates safety through three specialized annotators plus majority vote and responsibility through three ChatPLUG-13B top-k candidates scored 1–10 by the originating expert. Automatic construction categorizes multiple-LLM responses, uses ChatGPT to fill a missing opposite-value class, pairs opposite responses, and swaps option order, producing 4,312 MCQs (2,600 safety and 1,712 responsibility). Official evaluation reports accuracy including refusals and accuracy excluding refusals, with optional manual resolution of unparsed predictions.
